findings.subject: chat-composer
findings.summary: Pressing the stop button with the keyboard drops focus to the page: when status returns to idle with an empty field, the focused button becomes a disabled send button.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k09-chat-1. packages/ui-react/src/components/chat-composer/chat-composer.tsx:235-273 (one Button slot switches stop -> send with disabled={!canSend} at :267); nothing moves focus back to the textarea. Code reasoning, not run in a browser.
findings.fix: When the submit slot holds focus and turns disabled (busy -> idle with empty text, or after send), move focus to the textarea; add a browser test that presses stop via keyboard and asserts document.activeElement is the field.

findings.subject: chat-composer
findings.summary: The inline layout only detects wrapping inside onChange, so long text that arrives by prefill, a long defaultValue without a newline, or a narrower container stays in the radius-full pill while it wraps.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k09-chat-2. packages/ui-react/src/components/chat-composer/chat-composer.tsx:158-161 (multiline from wrappedAt or a newline), :200-207 (wraps() called only in onChange); chat-composer.css pill radius while not multiline.
findings.fix: Measure in a layout effect on value and on resize (ResizeObserver on the field) instead of only in onChange, and add a story with a long single-line controlled prefill to the baselines.

findings.subject: chat-message
findings.summary: ChatMessage has no error state although its paired runtime @atom63/agent marks messages 'error'; a failed or stopped reply has no designed look, slot or baseline.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k09-chat-3. packages/agent/src/runtime/types.ts:2 (AgentMessageStatus includes 'error'); packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/chat-message.json:17 states rest and streaming only; no story shows a failed reply.
findings.fix: Add an error state to the contract (for example status="error" with a danger-toned inline notice and room for a retry action in the actions slot), a story and a baseline, and wire the chat-panel block to it.

findings.subject: message
findings.summary: A failed outgoing message looks almost the same as a delivered one: same accent bubble, only a 12px alert icon in the meta, no text and no retry.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k09-chat-4; unchanged at f7e5e419. apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-message-delivery-states-chromium-linux.png (failed row); message.tsx:37; message.css:143-150 (no data-status='failed' styling).
findings.fix: Design the failed state: e.g. danger-toned status icon or a 'Not delivered' line outside the bubble, plus an optional retry action; the placement is product direction.

findings.subject: message
findings.summary: Message's Themes story bypasses ThemeMatrix, so its baseline renders retro and terminal without the radius axis and does not show the per-theme archetype.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k09-chat-5; unchanged at f7e5e419. packages/ui-react/src/components/message/message.stories.tsx:161-181 vs packages/ui-react/src/components/story-probes.tsx:140-168; compare ui-react-message-themes-chromium-linux.png (rounded bubbles in retro/terminal) with ui-react-chatmessage-themes-chromium-linux.png (square in retro/terminal).
findings.fix: Render the Themes story inside ThemeMatrix (as the other four chat stories do), regenerate the baseline, then let YZ judge the per-theme look from the contact sheet.

findings.subject: chat-composer
findings.summary: With status submitted or streaming and no onStop, the stop button is enabled but does nothing.
findings.fix: Disable the stop button when onStop is not given.

findings.subject: chat-message
findings.summary: The aria-busy exemption only sees a ChatTypingIndicator that is a direct child by identity; a wrapped or memoised indicator stays behind aria-busy.
findings.fix: Detect the indicator from the DOM (a status region inside the content) or give ChatMessage an explicit prop such as typing, instead of matching element types.

findings.subject: chat-message
findings.summary: The story's message actions are ghost icon buttons without tone="muted", against AGENTS.md rule 6, and builders copy them.
findings.fix: Add tone="muted" to the Copy, Good response and Bad response buttons in the story (and the chat-panel block if it copies them).

findings.subject: chat-steps
findings.summary: A step title does not wrap long unbroken strings (only the description does), so a long tool path overflows when ChatSteps is used outside a ChatMessage.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k09-chat-11; unchanged at f7e5e419. chat-steps.css:107-120 (overflow-wrap only on .a63-ChatStep-description).

findings.subject: chat-composer
